title: Span of X
text: Consider what the 'span of X' refers to in the context of vectors and matrices. How does this span relate to the vectors in X?

hintAnswer: hat{Y} is the orthogonal projection of Y onto the span of X.
title: Choosing the Correct Interpretation
text: Which of the following best describes the geometric interpretation of the OLS prediction vector hat{Y}?
choices: hat{Y} is the difference between Y and the orthogonal projection of Y onto the span of X.
hat{Y} is the orthogonal projection of Y onto the span of X.
When X is not full column rank, hat{Y} is still uniquely determined because the normal equation always has a single solution.
hat{Y} is the orthogonal projection of X onto the span of Y.
